create_Fmri_model: create an Fmri Pydantic model instance to process fMRI neuroimaging data with MapInfra caching
run_Fmri_prepare: run the Fmri prepare method to extract and cache fMRI events from a DataFrame or segment list
run_Fmri_call: run the Fmri callable to extract a torch tensor for a given start time and duration window
review_Fmri_preprocess_event: review the Fmri _preprocess_event method that cleans fMRI data using nilearn signal zscore standardization
summarize_Fmri_get_timed_arrays: summarize the Fmri _get_timed_arrays method that yields TimedArray objects from preprocessed fMRI event data
